newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 up, closes just below record as Dow slips.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 up, closes just below record as Dow slips.

text.p: UK shares finished just below all-time closing highs on Tuesday after profit-taking on Wall Street knocked stocks off record levels set earlier in the day, traders said.

After hitting a new peak of 3,933.6 on the back of Monday's surge in U.S. shares, follow-through buying failed to materialise and momentum flagged. But the new level topped the index's previous best of 3,922.1 set on August 28.
Profit-taking on Wall Street deprived the London market of any fresh impetus in the afternoon and the FTSE 100 lost ground to finish at 3,916.1, a rise of just 5.3 points.
